--auto-bail.help: Automatically stop scanning when an excessive amount of errors are encountered

--auto-tune.help: Automatically lower scan rate when an excessive amount of errors are encountered

--burp.help: Set --proxy to http://127.0.0.1:8080 and set --insecure to true

--burp-replay.help: Set --replay-proxy to http://127.0.0.1:8080 and set --insecure to true

--client-cert.help: Add a PEM encoded certificate for mutual authentication (mTLS)

--client-key.help: Add a PEM encoded private key for mutual authentication (mTLS)

--collect-backups.help: Automatically request likely backup extensions for "found" urls (default: ~, .bak, .bak2, .old, .1)

--collect-extensions.help: Automatically discover extensions and add them to --extensions (unless they're in

--collect-words.help: Automatically discover important words from within responses and add them to the wordlist

--cookies.help: Specify HTTP cookies to be used in each request (ex: -b stuff=things)

--data.help: Request's Body; can read data from a file if input starts with an @ (ex: @post.bin)

--data-json.help: Set -H 'Content-Type: application/json', --data to <data-json> (supports @file) and -m to POST

--data-urlencoded.help: Set -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded', --data to <data-urlencoded> (supports @file) and -m to POST

--debug-log.help: Output file to write log entries (use w/ --json for JSON entries)

--depth.help: Maximum recursion depth, a depth of 0 is infinite recursion (default: 4)

--dont-extract-links.help: Don't extract links from response body (html, javascript, etc...)

--dont-scan.help: URL(s) or Regex Pattern(s) to exclude from recursion/scans

--extensions.help: File extension(s) to search for (ex: -x php -x pdf js); reads values (newline-separated) from file if input starts with an @ (ex: @ext.txt)

--filter-lines.help: Filter out messages of a particular line count (ex: -N 20 -N 31,30)

--filter-regex.help: Filter out messages via regular expression matching on the response's body/headers (ex: -X '^ignore me$')

--filter-similar-to.help: Filter out pages that are similar to the given page (ex. --filter-similar-to http://site.xyz/soft404)

--filter-size.help: Filter out messages of a particular size (ex: -S 5120 -S 4927,1970)

--filter-words.help: Filter out messages of a particular word count (ex: -W 312 -W 91,82)

--force-recursion.help: Force recursion attempts on all 'found' endpoints (still respects recursion depth)

--headers.help: Specify HTTP headers to be used in each request (ex: -H Header:val -H 'stuff: things')

--insecure.help: Disables TLS certificate validation in the client

--json.help: Emit JSON logs to --output and --debug-log instead of normal text

--limit-bars.help: Number of directory scan bars to show at any given time (default: no limit)

--methods.help: Which HTTP request method(s) should be sent (default: GET)

--output.help: Output file to write results to (use w/ --json for JSON entries)

--parallel.help: Run parallel feroxbuster instances (one child process per url passed via stdin)

--protocol.help: Specify the protocol to use when targeting via --request-file or --url with domain only (default: https)

--proxy.help: Proxy to use for requests (ex: http(s)://host:port, socks5(h)://host:port)

--query.help: Request's URL query parameters (ex: -Q token=stuff -Q secret=key)

--quiet.help: Hide progress bars and banner (good for tmux windows w/ notifications)

--rate-limit.help: Limit number of requests per second (per directory) (default: 0, i.e. no limit)

--replay-codes.help: Status Codes to send through a Replay Proxy when found (default: --status-codes value)

--replay-proxy.help: Send only unfiltered requests through a Replay Proxy, instead of all requests

--request-file.help: Raw HTTP request file to use as a template for all requests

--response-size-limit.help: Limit size of response body to read in bytes (default: 4MB)

--resume-from.help: State file from which to resume a partially complete scan (ex. --resume-from ferox-1606586780.state)

--scan-dir-listings.help: Force scans to recurse into directory listings

--scan-limit.help: Limit total number of concurrent scans (default: 0, i.e. no limit)

--scope.help: Additional domains/URLs to consider in-scope for scanning (in addition to current domain)

--server-certs.help: Add custom root certificate(s) for servers with unknown certificates

--silent.help: Only print URLs (or JSON w/ --json) + turn off logging (good for piping a list of urls to other commands)

--status-codes.help: Status Codes to include (allow list) (default: All Status Codes)

--thorough.help: Use the same settings as --smart and set --collect-extensions and --scan-dir-listings to true

--time-limit.help: Limit total run time of all scans (ex: --time-limit 10m)

--timeout.help: Number of seconds before a client's request times out (default: 7)

--update.help: Update feroxbuster to the latest version

--verbosity.help: Increase verbosity level (use -vv or more for greater effect. [CAUTION] 4 -v's is probably too much)

--wordlist.help: Path or URL of the wordlist

-I.help: File extension(s) to Ignore while collecting extensions (only used with
